title: RideEvent (Kafka topic: ride-events)
description: STATUS: DRAFT v0.1. Freeze only after docs/dataset_card.md records the real pickup geography. event_id is deterministic: sha1(dataset_id + ':' + trip_id), so retries and restarts reproduce the same ID. Spark adds processed_at; it is NOT part of the message. Windows use event_ts only. Spark dedup keys: event_id + event_ts, within the watermark horizon (see config/settings.yaml).

event_id.description: Deterministic hash of dataset_id and trip_id.

event_ts.description: Historical pickup time, UTC (ISO 8601, ends with Z). Drives all windows.

emitted_at.description: When the producer published the event, UTC.

source_type.description: Historical records stay HISTORICAL_REPLAY even when replayed.

pickup_area_id.description: Community area or tract id, if the dataset has no usable coordinates.

simulation_run_id.description: Set only for SIMULATED events (e.g. surge injection).
